scope: Acquired scene-scoped official ROAD-Waymo links and native-ID context for the frozen kinematic population; no model or training.
authorization: User instructed closing ROAD gate and assumes independent clips/scenarios; individual image observations are Codex review, not attributed to user.

rule.accept: Verified frozen sources, unique scene-scoped official IDs, exact native export-pair presence/type, native/saved inventory/extents and same-frame FRONT images. Purposive review found no demonstrated wrong actor link.
rule.reject: Source/scope mismatch, ambiguous/shared official ID, conflicting repeat, absent native exported pair/type mismatch, or demonstrated wrong actor/identity switch.
rule.inconclusive: Disclose tiny/dark/occluded/truncated/out-of-FRONT views; retain on verified official link without claiming independent visual confirmation.
rule.missing: Keep missing observations. Native-only extensions have no ROAD GT; no interpolation, new association, speed-based GT or eligibility change.

selection: Eight frozen native cases; all non-Pedestrian native type tracks including context extensions; top three distinct clips each by maximum selected speed, minimum median ROAD box area, maximum same-frame ROAD pedestrian count. Ties: locator. Include velocity peak and immediate grid neighbors for velocity cases.
snapshot_rule: First/middle/last ROAD, disagreement, selected-position and non-Pedestrian-type times; first/last 3D-only extensions; velocity-peak immediate grid neighbors for velocity cases.
structural_result: Pass for all 9573 candidates / 562 clips; all source/component hashes and inventory/extents/IDs match; no ambiguous/shared ID, exported native pair/type mismatch, FRONT image absence or conflicting repeat encountered.
limitations: Purposive visual sample; no estimated population association error rate or full-video identity audit.
Several tiny/dark/occluded/native-only views cannot be independently confirmed; type disagreements are not all resolved semantically.
Native geometry can include bicycles and ROAD population includes scooter/wheeled human motion; original labels/types/geometry remain unchanged.
No independent RGB projection or sensor accuracy validation. Upstream acquisition/release revisions remain unknown; frozen acquired artifacts are reproducible.
Clip/scenario independence is the accepted user assumption, not an empirical claim.
Existing target/source inspection remains disclosed under E001 access rules.
unchanged: Accepted behavior overrides and target mapping
validation: 23 unittests passed on local CPU and aalto CUDA locked uv environments; native-only Cyclist context/missing-pair/source-guard fixture included.
